title: My account in sections
summary: My account now shows one section at a time, starting with your campaigns, and the sign-in form comes first.
items: Campaigns, Characters, Profile, Backups and Support are tabs; Campaigns opens first, and Resume leads each saved campaign's buttons.
Older links to a part of My account still open the right section.
Accounts that only play (no DM campaigns) no longer see the online-campaign hosting count or the DM encounters card; Open DM encounters stays as a short link.
The heading reads "My account" with your name below it.
On the sign-in page, Bug reports moved below the form, and a sign-in error appears right under the form and clears when you switch between Sign in and Create account.
